sentences.en: UB40 in the inner pocket, papers and baccy and lighter and keys: ready to practise her autograph!

Đi mất. Tôi đã hút thuốc lá của anh ấy.

sentences.en: I remember, I could odor the baccy in the region of your hand.

sentences.en: I love baccy, dear,[www.Sentencedict.com] more by token that it comes from the plantations to which the blessed woman was sent.

sentences.en: Stink of cologne and baccy, and all their Yankee hash.

sentences.en: "Line your old cloak?" shouted Mr. McGregor "I shall sell them and buy myself baccy ! "

sentences.en: This paper introduces a method of developing the output stack machine of FOCKE cigarette machine, based on the actual instance of corporation and using for the import baccy machine.

sentences.en: There aint a thing left here, ' said Merry, still feeling round among the bones, not a copper doit nor a baccy box.
sentences.vi: Có một thứ vẫn còn sót lại ở đây, - Merry nói, vẫn còn cảm giác tròn trịa giữa những cục xương, không phải một chiếc đồng hay hộp đựng thịt xông khói.
